0.headline: Runwal Enterprises IPO subscribed 21% on Day 1 so far; check latest GMP
0.heading: Runwal Enterprises IPO subscribed 21% on Day 1 so far; check latest GMP
0.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Mumbai-based real estate developer Runwal Enterprises saw a measured response from investors on the first day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 21 percent as of 1:45 pm on September 25, according to NSE data.
0.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Mumbai-based real estate developer Runwal Enterprises saw a measured response from investors on the first day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 21 percent as of 1:45 pm on September 25, according to NSE data.

The company received bids for 25,51,038 shares against 1,21,11,294 shares available for subscription. Among investor categories, qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) led the demand with 48 percent subscription. The retail portion was subscribed 12 percent, while the non-institutional investor (NII) category saw 8 percent subscription.

Runwal Enterprises shares were trading at a premium of around 2.5 percent over the IPO price in the grey market on the morning of September 25, according to InvestorGain.

Read Also: Orient Cables IPO subscribed 87% so far on Day 1; GMP at 39%

The company has fixed the price band for the IPO at Rs 290-305 per share. At the upper end of the price band, the grey market premium indicates an estimated premium of around Rs 7 per share.

Grey market premiums are unofficial indicators and can change during the subscription period. They should not be considered a guarantee of the listing price.

Ahead of the public issue, Runwal Enterprises raised Rs 148.9 crore from anchor investors. The company allotted 48.83 lakh shares to nine institutional investors at Rs 305 per share, the upper end of the price band.

Tata Mutual Fund emerged as the largest investor in the anchor book, picking up 13.11 lakh shares for Rs 40 crore. Maybank Securities was allotted 8.19 lakh shares worth Rs 25 crore, while Authum Investment and Infrastructure acquired 6.44 lakh shares for Rs 19.6 crore.

The anchor book also saw participation from 360 ONE WAM, Sanshi Fund, Founders Collective Fund, Capri Global Capital, Ashika Global Finance and LRSD Securities.

The Subodh Runwal-promoted company is looking to raise Rs 500 crore through the IPO, which consists entirely of a fresh issue of equity shares. The issue opened on September 25 and will close on September 29.

A substantial portion of the proceeds is earmarked for debt reduction. Runwal Enterprises plans to deploy Rs 325 crore towards repayment of borrowings taken by the company and its subsidiaries, Runwal Residency and Evie Real Estate.

Check IPO News Here

The remaining funds will be used for acquisitions of future real estate projects and general corporate purposes.

As of July 2026, Runwal Enterprises had standalone borrowings of Rs 431.4 crore. Evie Real Estate and Runwal Residency had outstanding borrowings of Rs 356.4 crore and Rs 286.5 crore, respectively.

Runwal Enterprises has a sizeable project pipeline across Mumbai's real estate market. As of March 2026, the company had 28 ongoing projects spanning 19.88 million square feet, while another 33 projects covering 56.41 million square feet were in the upcoming project pipeline. The developer has completed 19 projects so far.

ICICI Securities and Jefferies India are the book-running lead managers for the Runwal Enterprises IPO.

1.headline: Orient Cables IPO subscribed 87% so far on Day 1; GMP at 39%
1.heading: Orient Cables IPO subscribed 87% so far on Day 1; GMP at 39%
1.intro: The Gurugram-headquartered Orient Cables has opened its initial public offering (IPO) today, with the issue receiving 87 percent subscription as of 1:00 pm on September 25, as per NSE data.
1.body:
The Gurugram-headquartered Orient Cables has opened its initial public offering (IPO) today, with the issue receiving 87 percent subscription as of 1:00 pm on September 25, as per NSE data.

The Rs 552-crore IPO received 1,30,58,210 shares against 1,49,76,743 shares on offer. The non-institutional investor (NII) portion was subscribed 1.27 times, while the retail investor category saw 1.20 times subscription.

In the grey market, Orient Cables shares were commanding a premium of around Rs 105 over the upper end of the IPO price band, implying a premium of around 39 percent over the upper price band of Rs 27, according to market-tracking platform InvestorGain.

Read Also: A-One Steels India IPO subscribed 80% so far on Day 2; GMP at 12%

However, GMP is an unofficial indicator based on activity in the grey market and can change before listing. It does not guarantee the actual listing price.

The Orient Cables IPO is a book-built issue priced in the range of Rs 258-272 per share. The public issue comprises a fresh issue of equity shares worth Rs 320 crore and an offer-for-sale (OFS) of shares worth up to Rs 232 crore by promoter Nagpal family. The issue will remain open until September 29.

The company had raised Rs 165.6 crore from anchor investors ahead of the IPO opening. It allotted 60.88 lakh shares at Rs 272 apiece, the upper end of the price band. A substantial portion of the anchor allocation went to domestic mutual funds, including Nippon Life India, ICICI Prudential AMC, Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC, Motilal Oswal AMC, Invesco, Bandhan Mutual Fund, Sundaram Mutual Fund and Edelweiss.

The IPO's minimum lot size is 55 shares, requiring an investment of Rs 14,960 at the upper end of the price band. The shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on October 5.

Orient Cables plans to use a significant portion of the fresh issue proceeds to strengthen its manufacturing capabilities and reduce debt.

Of the Rs 320 crore raised through the fresh issue, Rs 91.5 crore will be used for purchasing machinery and equipment and carrying out civil works at its manufacturing facilities. Another Rs 155.5 crore has been earmarked for repayment of debt, while the balance will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

As of June 2026, Orient Cables had total outstanding borrowings of Rs 258.4 crore, including Rs 240.4 crore under secured fund-based facilities.

Orient Cables manufactures networking cables and passive networking equipment, along with specialty power and optical fibre cables and wire and cable harness assemblies. Its products cater to segments including broadband, telecom, data centres, renewable energy and smart building automation.

The company is looking to tap investor demand at a time when the IPO market has seen considerable activity, with Orient Cables among several issues opening for subscription on September 25.

IIFL Capital Services and JM Financial are the merchant bankers managing the Orient Cables IPO.

2.headline: ArMee Infotech IPO subscribed 1.6x on Day 3 so far - Check GMP
2.heading: ArMee Infotech IPO subscribed 1.6x on Day 3 so far - Check GMP
2.intro: ArMee Infotech IPO allotment is expected by September 28, while share listing is proposed to take place on September 30.
2.body:
ArMee Infotech IPO got subscribed 1.6 times on the final day of bidding on Friday.

The Rs 300-crore IPO received bids for 1.2 crore shares against 74.30 lakh shares on offer, translating into 1.62 times subscription, as per NSE data till 12:45 p.m.

The portion reserved for non-institutional investors was subscribed 1.34 times, while the retail investor quota received 1.89 times subscription. The qualified institutional buyers' (QIBs) portion was subscribed 95 percent.

Ahmedabad-based IT infrastructure and managed services company ArMee Infotech mobilised Rs 39.93 crore from four anchor investors.
Check All IPO News
ArMee Infotech IPO GMP Today Price
According to platforms tracking grey market activities, the shares of ArMee Infotech are commanding a GMP of up to 5 percent. Investorgain quoted a GMP of Rs 16 for the shares of the company, indicating a listing gain of 4.27 percent. IPO Watch, meanwhile, quoted a GMP of 5.33 percent.

The issue has a price band of Rs 350-375 per share.

ArMee Infotech has also ventured into renewable energy, providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) services for solar power projects, developing solar power projects under power purchase agreements (PPAs), and offering Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) solutions.

ArMee Infotech IPO allotment is expected by September 28, while share listing is proposed to take place on September 30.
